_comment: Flag-name fix: this ability read a flag NOTHING ever set, so it could never fire. The engine records fusion as "fused_<slug>" (ability_keywords.fusion), boost as "boosted_this_turn", and a played Lightning card as "played_lightning" — all lowercase. Was: FUSED. The effect was PAY_OR_DAMAGE -- pay or take damage -- where the card says 'they DISCARD A CARD unless they pay {r}'. That is PAY_OR_ELSE with a DISCARD, the same shape as coronet_peak and winters_bite_yellow. Its target 'hero' and its resource_cost/damage_amount keys were unread anyway. The fusion gate is left in place and is CORRECTLY inert: fusion is not implemented, so fused_<slug> is never set, and the card only does this if it was fused. Inert in the safe direction.
